errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the color for "акции (без АДСИЦ)" is brown ("кафяв"), when the chart legend and bars clearly show it as dark blue.
The description incorrectly transcribes part of a legend category. The legend says "Борсово търгувани продукти" (Exchange-traded products), not "борсово търгувани облигации" (Exchange-traded bonds).
The description incorrectly states that the color for the "други" (others) category is cinnamon-colored ("коричен"). The chart legend and bars show this category in bright red.

errors.text_span: през 2012 година най-висока стойност има сегментът на държавни ценни книжа (около 420 млн. лв.)
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect in multiple ways. The largest segment in 2012 is "Акции (без АДСИЦ)" (dark blue), not "сегментът на държавни ценни книжа" (black). Furthermore, the black segment for government securities does not even appear in the bar for 2012.

errors.text_span: докато през 2020 година най-висока стойност има категорията „други“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies "други" (others) as the category with the highest value in 2020. In reality, the largest segment in 2020 is "Акции (без АДСИЦ)" (dark blue), while "други" is one of the smallest segments.

This value is completely wrong for any category in 2020. The total value of the entire bar for 2020 is only slightly above 400 million BGN. A value greater than 1500 million is not present anywhere in the chart for the year 2020.
